description: This file contains an integration test class named SavingsInterestPostingTest for the Apache Fineract project. The test verifies the correct posting of interest across multiple savings accounts by creating accounts, depositing funds, running scheduled jobs, and validating account balances against transaction data.

classes.name: SavingsInterestPostingTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing interest posting logic on multiple savings accounts within the Apache Fineract system.

classes.name: AccountWithDepositAmount
classes.description: Helper class to track individual savings account IDs and their total deposited amount during tests.

methods.name: testSavingsInterestPosting_Works_ForMultipleAccounts
methods.description: Main test method that creates multiple savings accounts, deposits funds over several days, runs interest posting job, and validates account balances against transaction data.

methods.name: addDeposit
methods.description: Method in AccountWithDepositAmount class to add a deposit amount to the account's total.
